findings.title: Incorrect shipping banner for exactly $50.00
findings.detail: The shipping_banner function checks if remaining < 0 to show 'Your order ships free!', but when subtotal is exactly $50.00, remaining is 0. This results in the banner showing 'Add $0.00 more for free shipping' instead of the correct 'Your order ships free!'. [upgraded to blocking: probe confirmed by execution; reviewer said major]
findings.evidence: The current code uses 'if remaining < 0' which fails to trigger the free shipping message when remaining is 0.
findings.suggestion: Change the condition to 'if remaining <= 0' to correctly handle exactly $50.00 orders.
